title: Motorcar Parts of America Extends Credit Facility With PNC Bank
summary: LOS ANGELES, August 06, 2026--Motorcar Parts of America, Inc. (Nasdaq:MPAA) today announced it has extended the maturity date of the company’s $238.62 million revolving credit facility led by PNC Bank, N.A., to August 2031.
